findings.detail: CBSE Board preset successfully configures subject-specific visible sections (A: Biology, B: Chemistry, C: Physics) with matching subject_area properties on the Slots.
QuestionPicker correctly isolates candidates by chapter.subject_area filtering when present, while preserving non-board/no-subject behavior when subject_area is None.
seeded_bank fixture correctly retrieves and maps seeded NCERT chapters by subject area strands to populate the test question pool.
PaperDocumentBuilder correctly sets visible numbering to 39, sharing display numbers across OR-group slots within each section.
The bank lookup section remains qtype-derived (Section A for MCQ, B for VSA, C for SA, D for LA, E for CASE) regardless of the visible paper section mapping.
Frontend coverage form hook and structure summaries align perfectly with the backend format metadata and correctly handle fallback preset scaling.
